data.title: Address Beachfront
data.about:
Introducing Address Residences – The Bay.

Located within the private island of Emaar Beachfront, this fantastic waterfront project offers a collection of apartments, penthouses, and townhouses. Choose from 1 – 3 bedroom apartments. Amazing homes with enviable interiors, this is the place to buy your new home in Dubai.

location_tile.title: Address Residences The Bay is located in Emaar Beachfront.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Emaar Beachfront is a fantastic waterfront project with beautiful apartments and views like no other. Nestled just minutes from Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, this is very easily accessible. With access to a 1.5km pristine beach and a private island lifestyle, this is the perfect place to live your ultimate life.

  • Directly connected with Al Sufouh Road
  • 5 minutes to Dubai Marina & Palm
  • 8 minutes to Mall of The Emirates
  • 15 minutes to Burj Khalifa & Dubai Mall
  • 25 minutes to Dubai Intl. Airport
